# Tesla 2026 Q2 source facts

`tsla-2026-q2-facts.json` is a filtered copy of the public [SEC Company Facts response](https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001318605.json). It includes 15 standard-taxonomy concepts for April 1–June 30, 2026, from accession `0001628280-26-049270`, filed July 23, 2026. Original concept labels, descriptions, amounts, and every retained fact field are unchanged. Other concepts, periods, accessions, and currencies were omitted. No values or source fields were synthesized.

The [official statement of operations](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026049270/R4.htm) and [original 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026049270/tsla-20260630.htm) independently show consolidated net income of $1,128 million, noncontrolling interests of $14 million, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $1,114 million. The EPS numerator of $1,116 million is a separate concept and must not replace reported net income.

This fixture supports tests only; it is not a new bundled company or production snapshot.
